translation: So I rubbed beside the neck, and there were those surging up on left and right, those spreading in a circle to Quepen and rising like a tube, and those attached to the bone and spine rising thick and large; I rubbed them away as they came. Feeling the front of the neck, its shape was like a great snake, above the back and below the abdomen, with ridges rising like water waves, the tip like a knife blade, filling the Adam's apple; this is why it caused a choking cough, and it was extremely frightening. I thought that the previous accumulation in front of the neck was drawn by rubbing above the ear gate, so now I also rubbed as before, and it went up following the hand, at first a little over an inch wide, in the middle nearly three inches, still as before from the temples and forehead to the crown and down the back of the neck, finishing in about two hours, with a length like a journey, not just one or two zhang; still like a snake in shape, only changed to flat.
